title: Reproducibility package for an auditable cross-scale provenance recovery framework for fragmented geological records
description: This release provides the reproducibility package for the manuscript 'An Auditable Cross-Scale Provenance Recovery Framework for Fragmented Geological Records'. It includes a minimal method demo, the full released tabular dataset, normalization rules, field inventory, regenerated linkage outputs, and validation scripts that regenerate the 1400-row linkage table and verify the reported summary statistics.
